name: intervals-icu-planner
description: Plan a whole training block with Claude and put it on your intervals.icu calendar, safely.
long_description: Push, inspect, move and remove whole training plans (a plan.yaml plus .zwo workouts) on your intervals.icu calendar, and read your fitness and completed rides. Every write is a dry run first and only touches events the plan created.

api_key.title: intervals.icu API key
api_key.description: intervals.icu → Settings → Developer Settings → API key. Stored in your system keychain.

tools.name: push_plan
tools.description: Validate a plan, diff it against the calendar, and add or update its events (dry run by default)

tools.name: get_planned
tools.description: List planned events, optionally only one plan's

tools.name: delete_plan
tools.description: Remove every event a plan created, nothing else (dry run by default)

tools.name: get_fitness
tools.description: Fitness, fatigue and form per day

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Completed rides: time, distance, load, power, heart rate

tools.name: move_workout
tools.description: Move one session to another day in plan.yaml and on the calendar (dry run by default)

tools.name: shift_plan
tools.description: Push the rest of a plan back by N weeks (dry run by default)

tools.name: plan_guide
tools.description: How to write a plan: the plan.yaml format, .zwo rules and examples
